parsed.name: 管式炉CVD配方控制组件
parsed.description: 用于管式炉CVD系统的非物理配方执行软件组件。它根据预定义步骤协调炉温、质量流量控制器和压力相关参数，支持设备初始化、过程执行、参数轮询与运行日志记录，适合自动化工艺流程管理。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical recipe execution software component for a tube furnace CVD system. It coordinates furnace temperature, mass flow controller settings, and pressure-related parameters according to predefined steps, and supports device initialization, process execution, parameter polling, and run logging for automated process management.

actions.description: 执行整套工艺配方，按步骤设置炉温和气体流量，并在各步骤中等待温度接近设定值及保持规定时间。
actions.description_en: Run the full process recipe by stepwise setting furnace temperature and gas flow rates, then waiting for temperature to approach the setpoint and holding each step for the specified time.

actions.description: 初始化并验证配方所需设备的通信与可用状态。
actions.description_en: Initialize the recipe and verify communication and availability of the required devices.

actions.description: 按设定频率记录运行参数并写入日志文件。
actions.description_en: Log operating parameters at a specified frequency and write them to a log file.

actions.description: 轮询相关设备，读取当前运行参数并汇总返回。
actions.description_en: Poll the associated devices to read current operating parameters and return them in a combined result.
